tools.name: list_eor_providers
tools.description: List and filter the 62 employer of record (EOR) providers BestEOR.co tracks, with each one's published monthly fee per employee (or quote-only), countries covered, owned-entity footprint, delivery model and primary-source links. A fee ceiling or coverage minimum only matches providers that publish t

tools.name: get_eor_provider
tools.description: Get one EOR provider's published fee (or quote-only terms), EOR country coverage, owned-entity footprint, delivery model, what it is best for, and the primary-source URL behind each figure. Accepts a name or slug, e.g. 'Deel', 'Remote', 'Globalization Partners', 'oyster-hr'.

tools.name: compare_eor_providers
tools.description: Compare two or three EOR providers side by side on published fee, country coverage, owned entities and delivery model, with primary sources and a link to the matching BestEOR.co comparison page.

tools.name: get_country_employment_costs
tools.description: Get what it costs and what the law requires to employ someone in a country: the employer's statutory contribution rate (or fixed amounts), minimum wage, annual leave, notice, severance, probation and other terms, each with its primary source. Accepts a country name, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or slug,

tools.name: estimate_eor_cost
tools.description: Estimate the annual and monthly cost of employing people in a country through an EOR: gross salary, plus the country's representative employer contribution rate, plus the EOR fee (a provider's published fee, or one you supply from a quote), plus other monthly costs. A budget illustration, not a payr

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_eor_provider · Private data: list_eor_providers · Public sink: list_eor_providers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_eor_provider · Private data: list_eor_providers · Public sink: list_eor_providers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_eor_providers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List and filter the 62 employer of record (EOR) providers BestEOR.co tracks, with each one's published monthly fee per employee (or quote-only), countries covered, owned-entity footprint, delivery model and primary-source links. A fee ceiling or coverage minimum only matches providers that publish t" → after: "List and filter the 75 employer of record (EOR) providers BestEOR.co tracks, with each one's published monthly fee per employee (or quote-only), countries covered, owned-entity footprint, delivery model and primary-source links. A fee ceiling or coverage minimum only matches providers that publish t"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
